import json,os,pathlib,httpx
from google import genai
from google.genai import types
from google.oauth2.credentials import Credentials
from orchestration.beta_vertex_research import BetaVertexResearchRuntime
p=pathlib.Path('/opt/ocean')
assert os.geteuid()==10001 and os.getegid()==10001
m=json.loads((p/'source-manifest.json').read_text())
assert m['revision']=='0f15bbcae3ad73ed76ddb32dd57b3a03dbedb49f'
# This runs inside the qualified API image under nonroot, network-none/read-only.
import importlib.metadata
from orchestration.research_controller_replay import controller_fingerprint
from orchestration.research_evidence_projection import SUPPORTED_CONTROLLER_FINGERPRINTS
from orchestration.research_synthesis import selection_schema
from schema.research_controller import canonical_json, controller_action_schema, parse_controller_action
assert importlib.metadata.version('google-genai') == '2.25.0'
assert controller_fingerprint() == 'cf87f56712ccf4eddb03fe944e9bb293132163e881fdea38bb515b103c2641a5'
assert controller_fingerprint() in SUPPORTED_CONTROLLER_FINGERPRINTS
assert m['sources']['orchestration/beta_vertex_research.py'] == '063aac4b7600cb883af5ea15b2534ba35a26d9957f04c5cf09347b37685ce1aa'
synthetic_tool = {'kind': 'tool', 'tool': 'catalogue.open', 'arguments': {'object_id': 'synthetic:ctd'}, 'fact_ids': ['requested:1']}
for contract in ['controller', 'synthesis']:
    schema = controller_action_schema() if contract == 'controller' else selection_schema()
    original = canonical_json(schema)
    content = synthetic_tool if contract == 'controller' else {'version': 'c21-selection-v1', 'blocks': []}
    actual_requests = []
    def actual_respond(request):
        actual_requests.append(request)
        return httpx.Response(200, json={'candidates': [{'content': {'role': 'model', 'parts': [{'text': json.dumps(content)}]}, 'finishReason': 'STOP'}]})
    with genai.Client(vertexai=True, project='ocean-v1-beta-20261101', location='global', credentials=Credentials(token='synthetic-test-only'), http_options=types.HttpOptions(api_version='v1', retry_options=types.HttpRetryOptions(attempts=1), client_args={'transport': httpx.MockTransport(actual_respond)})) as client:
        runtime = BetaVertexResearchRuntime(project='ocean-v1-beta-20261101', location='global', embedding_dim=768, max_attempts=1, client=client)
        result = runtime.structured_chat_result(model='gemini-3.8-flash', prompt='Synthetic offline provider-contract proof', schema=schema, max_output_tokens=4096, timeout=10)
    assert result.status == 'completed' and len(actual_requests) == 1
    assert actual_requests[0].url.host == 'aiplatform.googleapis.com'
    assert actual_requests[0].url.path.endswith('/locations/global/publishers/google/models/gemini-3.8-flash:generateContent')
    actual_config = json.loads(actual_requests[0].content)['generationConfig']
    assert set(actual_config) == {'responseMimeType', 'responseJsonSchema', 'maxOutputTokens', 'thinkingConfig'}
    assert actual_config['maxOutputTokens'] == 4096
    assert actual_config['thinkingConfig'] == {'thinking_level': 'LOW', 'include_thoughts': False}
    wire_schema = actual_config['responseJsonSchema']
    assert '"const":' not in json.dumps(wire_schema)
    assert canonical_json(schema) == original
    if contract == 'controller':
        for definition, kind in [('ToolAction', 'tool'), ('ClarifyAction', 'clarify'), ('FinishAction', 'finish')]:
            assert wire_schema[chr(36)+'defs'][definition]['properties']['kind']['enum'] == [kind]
            assert schema[chr(36)+'defs'][definition]['properties']['kind']['const'] == kind
        assert parse_controller_action(result.require_completed(), fact_ids=('requested:1',)).model_dump() == synthetic_tool
        try:
            parse_controller_action(json.dumps({**synthetic_tool, 'kind': 'unknown'}), fact_ids=('requested:1',))
        except ValueError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError('Unknown model action kind was accepted')
    else:
        assert wire_schema['properties']['version']['enum'] == ['c21-selection-v1']
        for definition, kind in [('FactSelection', 'fact'), ('RowSelection', 'rows'), ('RelationshipSelection', 'relationship'), ('DocumentarySelection', 'documentary')]:
            assert wire_schema[chr(36)+'defs'][definition]['properties']['kind']['enum'] == [kind]
failed_requests = []
def unavailable(request):
    failed_requests.append(request)
    return httpx.Response(503, json={'error': {'code': 503, 'status': 'UNAVAILABLE', 'message': 'Synthetic offline failure'}})
with genai.Client(vertexai=True, project='ocean-v1-beta-20261101', location='global', credentials=Credentials(token='synthetic-test-only'), http_options=types.HttpOptions(api_version='v1', retry_options=types.HttpRetryOptions(attempts=1), client_args={'transport': httpx.MockTransport(unavailable)})) as client:
    runtime = BetaVertexResearchRuntime(project='ocean-v1-beta-20261101', location='global', embedding_dim=768, max_attempts=1, client=client)
    failed = runtime.structured_chat_result(model='gemini-3.8-flash', prompt='Synthetic offline failure proof', schema=controller_action_schema(), max_output_tokens=4096, timeout=10)
assert failed.status == 'failed' and len(failed_requests) == 1
print('Frozen actual SDK controller/synthesis singleton enums, unchanged replay inputs/parser/fingerprint and one-attempt503 verified offline')
